'''Imeici Spire''' was a tower that was constructed on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and used by the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] as a base to run the [[Sarlacc Project]]. Inside it they kept various designers, whom they forced to design a [[Super Star Destroyer prototype]].

It was destroyed during the [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|Mission to Coruscant]], when Inquisitor [[Nolor]] initiated the tower's self-destruct in an attempt to stop the [[Alderaanian Resistance]].
